req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should serve an interactive Swagger UI at the endpoint GET /docs. This is a critical feature for API observability, allowing clients to explore and interact with the API. The test suite includes a positive test to ensure the Swagger UI is served correctly, a negative test to handle unexpected errors, and a boundary test to verify the response under edge conditions.

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_positive
preconditions: The database is initialized with the pre-loaded data.
actions: Send a GET request to the /docs endpoint.
expected: The response contains the Swagger UI HTML content.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/docs')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert '<title>Swagger UI</title>' in response.text

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_negative
preconditions: The database is initialized with the pre-loaded data.
actions: Simulate a server error by mocking the FastAPI app to raise an exception when accessing /docs.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from fastapi import HTTPException

app.get('/docs')(lambda: (_ for _ in ()).throw(HTTPException(status_code=500)))
client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/docs')
assert response.status_code == 500

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_boundary
preconditions: The database is initialized with the pre-loaded data.
actions: Send a GET request to the /docs endpoint with a large number of query parameters.
expected: The response contains the Swagger UI HTML content.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)
query_params = {f'param{i}': 'value' for i in range(100)}
response = client.get('/docs', params=query_params)
assert response.status_code == 200
assert '<title>Swagger UI</title>' in response.text
